items.text: Dayna S. Williams-Hunter is the elected City Clerk of Hawthorne, a position she has held since 2022. She has a background in public relations. She runs private businesses. She has taken courses to become a certified municipal clerk.

sentences.text: Dayna S. Williams-Hunter is the elected City Clerk of Hawthorne, a position she has held since 2022.
She has a background in public relations.
She has taken courses to become a certified municipal clerk.

items.text: Her official biography says she introduced new software for public records requests and agenda creation, and integrated AI to reduce paper use in council meetings. She started a two-year project to digitize the office's historical records.
